'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Tony G LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tony G]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''The Claw'''. Username '''tazmizzionz'''. Printed list. Obj Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion]]
* '''Username:''' tazmizzionz
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
